name: Thusnelda
notes: AC 12 (natural). Germanic seer and keeper of the northern bogs. Inheritor of the ancient lineage that sealed the Spear of Mars after Alesia.
gm_notes: Seer of the Black Bog. Her teacher's teacher bound the Spear of Mars alongside Gallic druids two centuries ago. Guides worthy travelers across the sinking peat and will-o'-the-wisps to the sacrificial grove. Secret: holds the ancient amber token and bog trails bypassing the cult's ambushes, and knows Vercingetorix's binding requires a willing soul to take the chains if unmade.
objective: Prevent the blood cult from unsealing the Spear of Mars and unleashing perpetual slaughter.
goal: Test the party's moral courage; guide them through the Black Bog if they fight to end the killing.
agenda: Speak in omens to pierce Roman arrogance; steer the contubernium toward the true vault entrance.
secret: Her lineage sealed the vault after Alesia; she knows unmaking the spear requires someone to take the guardian's seat.
